Today’s Man City vs Brighton live streams see first play third in the Premier League 2026/27 , with both sides seeking a return to winning ways after respective league losses last weekend. Unusually for such a big game, it's a 3pm GMT kick-off in the UK on Saturday afternoon.
Despite all of the controversy and those 114 charges off the field, City have been quite brilliant on it. Until last weekend, they'd won all seven of their league games with Erling Haaland looking as sharp in front of goal as his natty new haircut. That run came to an abrupt end at Villa Park, however, with Senegalese striker Nicolas Jackson scoring twice in the Villans' 2-1 win . With Antoine Semenyo out long-term, much seems to rest on the shoulders of the big Norwegian, while Gianluigi Donnarumma's form between the sticks has been called into question of late.
And now they face a side that they've failed to beat at the last four times of asking in the EPL and, it doesn't feel too optimistic to suggest, are in the hunt for a Champions League spot of their own next season. A 3-0 walloping of champions Arsenal last month proved that Fabian Hürzeler's men have what it takes to beat the very best and, with 23 goals in eight outings, they're the top scorers in the division. They were well beaten last time out at Anfield (with Pascal Gross scoring at the wrong end, for a change), so Seagulls fans will hope Charalampos Kostoulas has packed his scoring boots for the trip north today.
Can Brighton bloody the noses of their hosts? Or will City get the job done like they did in the Carabao Cup on Wednesday? Here's how to watch Man City vs Brighton in the 2026/27 Premier League from anywhere in the world.
